newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC extends bourse self-regulatory licence.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC extends bourse self-regulatory licence.

text.p: The license of the Philippine Stock Exchange to operate as a self regulatory agency had been temporarily extended, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) chairman Perfecto Yasay told reporters on Friday.

Yasay said the SEC has temporarily extended the bourse's self regulatory licence, which expired Thursday, until the SEC reviewed the accomplishments of the exchange since it was granted such status on December 16.
"Until such time that we have completed the review on the PSE papers, we cannot act on its application for a licence to become a permanent self-regulatory organisation," Yasay said.

The review will look at the bourse's regulatory framework which includes the formation of an effective, surveillance, compliance and enforcement department to check on the activities of brokers and proper disclosures by listed companies.
Yasay also said the SEC will review the listing guidelines of the bourse. "We want a more objective way of evaluating initial public offerings," he said.
